correctness.rationale: Discounted endpoint hitting functions solve Duʺ=ru and are sinh(k(L−x))/sinh(kL) and sinh(kx)/sinh(kL). Geometric renewal normalizes their weighted sums; the sign difference reduces to Σ c_j sinh(k a_j). Strict positivity of all ordered minors of the sinh kernel follows by the absolutely convergent power expansion and products of generalized Vandermonde determinants. Therefore an m-term nontrivial sum has at most m−1 positive distinct zeros; alternating cofactor interpolation constructs exactly m−1 sign reversals at arbitrary prescribed positive rates. Explicit signed weights (25,−10,1)/36 at distances (d,2d,3d) factor as sinh(z)(cosh(z)−2)(cosh(z)−3)/9, yielding exactly two rates. Independently verified renewal identities, determinant positivity and three-site factors (10 checks).
